sloka: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा जाम्बवान् वाक्यमब्रवीत्।शृणु नैर्ऋतशार्दूल यस्मात् पृच्छामि मारुतिम् ।। ६.७४.२१ ।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā jāmbavān vākyamabravīt।śṛṇu nairṛtaśārdūla yasmāt pṛcchāmi mārutim ।। 6.74.21 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Vibheeshana, the tiger among Rakshasas, Jambavan replied, "Listen why I enquired about Maruthi."
